thread:
marya: FYI — we had a saturation storm in us-west GPU pool at 07:10 UTC. dozens of saturation alerts triggered, error budget reporting spiked.
chris: saw that. graphs show queue_depth and rpc_backlog rising before CPU/GPU util. might be head-of-line queuing in the ingress LB.
aditi: can you paste the PromQL you used?
marya: PromQL: `max_over_time(sum by(node) (queue_depth) [5m]) > 80`
ben: that query is noisy for short tails; suggest using a delta or increase window and a percentile, e.g. `quantile_over_time(0.95, queue_depth[5m])` with node grouping.
oncall-bot: Incident opened: #INC-9824 — saturation-flood-us-west (assigned to @chris)
chris: I also noticed an SLI mismatch: our 'availability' SLI uses pod_ready=true but doesn't account for pods that are ready yet stuck in Backlogged state. error budget is being consumed even when pods report ready.
aditi: proposal: define a new SLI 'inference-ready' = pod_ready && queue_depth < 50 && avg_latency_1m < 200ms. keep the current uptime SLI for control-plane health only.
marya: +1. Also want to reduce alert noise: consolidate saturation alerts into a single rollup per region using group_labels and add burn-rate thresholding (only page if EB consumption > 10% in 15m).
ben: agree. For Grafana: add a composite panel that shows SLI, EB remaining, and top-5 tenants by RPS so oncall can quickly spot noisy tenants.
sre-telemetry-bot: Note: EB exporter changed its schema last week; some dashboards under-report EB. runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/eb-export-format
chris: actionable steps:
- update node saturation PromQL to `max(queue_depth) by (node)` with a 5m moving-window smoothing
- add region rollup alert: `sum(queue_depth > 50) by (region) > 3` and apply EB gating
- create new SLI 'inference-ready' and backfill 30d to assess historical EB impact
- patch EB exporter to include short-window percentiles and include `window_seconds` metadata
aditi: I'll open a PR for the SLI definition and Grafana panel. who owns the EB exporter change?
marya: tagging @ben for exporter work. I'll draft the alert runbook updates and example playbook for pages.
ben: will take EB exporter. ETA: EOD tomorrow for a small schema bump, then a follow-up to dashboards.
chris: will follow up with LB team about ingress batching and head-of-line issues. moving active triage to #inc-9824.
marya: thanks all — logging follow-ups on the incident ticket and updating the SLO/EB tracking doc.
